title: PUT /reference/:token/answer autosave endpoint has happy-path-only coverage — bot-guard and all 6 error branches untested
detail: The POST path has dedicated honeypot/timing negative tests; the PUT path's identical AD-15 silent-drop and every error branch (400/404/409) have zero pins. A regression removing the PUT bot-guard or breaking 409s passes CI silently.
recommended_fix: Add integration tests: PUT with filled _website and with missing _form_loaded_at (assert 200 + draft_answers unchanged), plus malformed JSON 400, unknown-token 404, and closed-state 409.

title: Resend delivered branch: the reference_call_link_resent audit write is never executed by any test — negative pin only
detail: The AC 're-sends are audit-logged' has no positive pin: audit_resend's create_system call with event ReferenceCallLinkResent and entity_id wiring never runs. A wrong event-type/entity regression passes CI; the in-file NOTE overstates coverage (remint SQL yes, audit write no).
recommended_fix: Unit-test audit_resend with a Recording sentry and a stubbed delivered outcome, or extract the audit write behind an injectable seam and pin event type + entity_id; alternatively relax the NOTE to state the audit write is unpinned.

title: Router wiring of the /reference route family (incl. the AC7 catch-all arm) has no test — integration tests bypass the route table
evidence:
Tests call handlers directly: "fn get_form(db: pog.Connection, token: String) {
  let req = simulate.request(http.Get, "/reference/" <> token)
  form_handler.handle_get(req, test_server_config(db), token)
}"
Router arms (router.gleam:966-974) are never hit: "http.Get, ["reference", token] ->
      form_handler.handle_get(req, ctx.config, token)
    http.Post, ["reference", token, "answer"] ->
      form_handler.handle_answer_post(req, ctx.config, token)
    http.Put, ["reference", token, "answer"] ->
      form_handler.handle_answer_put(req, ctx.config, token)
    http.Post, ["reference", token, "resend"] ->
      form_handler.handle_resend(req, ctx.config, token)
    http.Get, ["reference", ..] -> form_handler.handle_unknown_path(req)"; router_test.gleam pins static assets only; handle_unknown_path has no test.
detail: The AC7 guarantee (typo'd deep links under /reference/* render the branded 404, never the analytics-loading SPA shell) depends on route-table arm order, which no test exercises. A reordering regressing the catch-all passes CI.
recommended_fix: Add route-level tests through wisp.simulate (or wisp_routes) for GET /reference/:token, POST/PUT answer, POST resend, and GET /reference/:token/typo asserting the branded 404.

title: clamp_current / ?q= deep-link positioning untested — the review screen's Change/Back navigation flow has no handler-level pin
evidence: clamp_current has no test in the chunk; the only ?q= pins are the PRG location ("string.contains(location, "?q=relationship") |> should.be_true") and the review href ("href=\"/reference/" <> token <> "?q=rent_amount#q-rent_amount\""). The three clamp branches ("True, Some(id), _ -> id", "_, _, Some(n) -> n.id", "_, _, None -> last_question_id(slot)") plus the answered-question validity check ("q.draft_keys |> list.all(fn(k) { list.contains(draft_keys, k) })") never execute in any test.
detail: A 'Change' click on the review screen issues GET ?q=<answered>; if clamp_current regressed to always snap to first-unanswered, review-screen navigation breaks with no test failing. Resume-with-deep-link positioning is likewise unpinned.
recommended_fix: Unit-test clamp_current (answered deep link kept, unanswered-non-first snapped, unknown id snapped, complete-set ?q= answered) and an integration test GETting ?q= on a live token.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: the mandated r1 redact fix is real and fully pinned (is_public_path x3, sentry_safe_path x2, access_log_line, redact_token_url all pass; /reference arm verified in redact_token_route), classifier matrix, resume, token states, POST abuse posture all pinned. P1 ~85-90%, overall ~86%: PUT endpoint at ~15% branch coverage, delivered-resend audit write unpinned, router wiring and clamp untested. Verified live: 1371 unit + 432 integration + 118 JS all pass.
recommended_fix: Add PUT negative/bot-guard integration tests and a positive audit-write pin to raise P1 above 90% and overall above 90%; route-level /reference tests plus clamp_current pins would make the gate PASS.
